title: Utilizing Earth Foundation Models to Enhance the Simulation Performance of Hydrological Models with AlphaEarth Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2601.01558v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate prediction in ungauged basins (PUB) requires effective transfer across hydrologically diverse regions. While deep learning has advanced large-sample hydrological modeling, its cross-regional generalization depends in part on the static basin descriptors used to guide model behavior. Earth Foundation Models (EFMs) provide a promising alternative by learning environmental representations from multi-modal satellite data. In this study, we evaluate the 64-dimensional AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) embeddings as a new form of static basin representation and assess their value for streamflow prediction under both in-sample (IS) and out-of-sample (OOS) settings using the CAMELS dataset. Results show that AEF embeddings offer higher OOS robustness than CAMELS attributes, despite nearly identical IS performance. translated_title: 利用地球基础模型的AlphaEarth嵌入提升水文模型的模拟性能
translated_abstract: 无观测流域的准确预测（PUB）需要在水文条件各异的区域之间进行有效迁移。尽管深度学习推动了大样本水文建模的发展，但其跨区域泛化能力在一定程度上依赖于用于引导模型行为的静态流域描述符。地球基础模型（EFMs）通过从多模态卫星数据中学习环境表征，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。在本研究中，我们评估了64维的AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）嵌入作为一种新的静态流域表征形式，并基于CAMELS数据集，在样本内（IS）和样本外（OOS）两种设置下评估了其对径流预测的价值。结果表明，尽管AEF嵌入的样本内性能与CAMELS属性几乎相当，但其样本外鲁棒性更高。互信息分析揭示了AEF嵌入与传统流域属性之间的统计关联……
tldr: 本研究将AlphaEarth嵌入作为静态流域表征用于无观测流域的径流预测，发现其样本外泛化鲁棒性优于传统CAMELS流域属性。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates 64-dimensional AlphaEarth embeddings as a new static basin representation for streamflow prediction, showing they provide higher out-of-sample robustness than conventional CAMELS attributes.
